title: Work for later
description:
Queue work from a high IRQL and run it later at a lower one, as DPCs and work items do.

```
ISR (DIRQL): read 3 bytes, queue DPC
DPC (DISPATCH): copy bytes into the ring buffer, queue a work item
work item (PASSIVE): write the log file
queued twice before running -> runs once (a DPC object can only be queued once)
```
hints: `if (dpc.queued) return false; dpc.queued = true; dpcQueue.push_back(&dpc); return true;` and clear the flag just before running it (lesson 3.04).
File access needs PASSIVE_LEVEL, which is why the DPC hands the writing to a work item.
requirements: Three queues for the three levels; run all higher-level work before lower-level work.
Queuing a DPC that is already queued does nothing and returns false, like `KeInsertQueueDpc`.
Each job prints the level it runs at.
stretch: Add a timer that queues its DPC every 100 ms of simulated time.
